title: Why didn't more people see it? Recommendation: Transparency for providers
abstract: arXiv:2608.21641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transparency in recommender systems has been widely studied from the perspective of those receiving recommendations, yet the needs of item providers, the creators whose content is distributed through these platforms, remain largely unexplored. Providers often lack insight into how their items do or do not receive exposure in users' recommendation lists. In this work, we address this gap by proposing a surrogate modeling approach to explain item exposure at a system level. Rather than explaining individual user-item pairs, we train a proxy model to approximate the exposure distribution produced by a recommender. By quantifying the contribution of each feature, we seek to explain the factors driving the recommendation model's decisions across the entire user base. translated_title: 为什么没有更多人看到它？建议：为提供者提供透明度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21641v1 公告类型：新 摘要：推荐系统中的透明度已从接收推荐者的角度得到了广泛研究，但物品提供者（即通过平台分发内容的创作者）的需求在很大程度上仍未得到探索。提供者通常缺乏对其物品在用户推荐列表中是否获得曝光或为何未获得曝光的洞察。在本工作中，我们通过提出一种代理建模方法来解决这一差距，以在系统层面解释物品曝光。我们不解释单个用户-物品对，而是训练一个代理模型来近似推荐系统产生的曝光分布。通过量化每个特征的贡献，我们旨在解释驱动推荐模型在整个用户群体中决策的因素。我们在两个数据集和三个推荐模型上评估了我们的方法。结果表明，代理模型能够以高保真度捕捉所有三个推荐系统的全局行为。
tldr: 本文提出了一种代理建模方法，用于在系统层面解释推荐系统中物品提供者的曝光分布，通过量化特征贡献来揭示驱动推荐决策的全局因素。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a surrogate modeling approach to explain item exposure distribution at a system level for providers in recommender systems, quantifying feature contributions to reveal global factors driving recommendation decisions.
